previous_statement: Apply lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control to the finite-dimensional C*-algebra B_U oplus B_V, the finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra A_R, and the extended delta-isomorphism v from 1.3. Here the target unit denoted I_{A_R} in that imported lemma is the designated unit u_{A_R} used in the root contract. The two-sided threshold in 1.4 gives ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R})<=abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1)*t<=D_3*t. Together with the extended D_3*t-isomorphism conclusion of 1.3, this is exactly the asserted output.
new_statement: The unit-control application is valid only under the additional hypotheses that B_U oplus B_V is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra and A_R is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra. Under those hypotheses, node 1.4 and lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control give ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}|| <= C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R}) <= abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1)*t <= D_3*t. However, neither the root antecedent nor def-four-corner-merging-datum supplies these two typing hypotheses, so this application cannot presently discharge the root conclusion; the root must be repaired by adding the types (and, for node 1.3, the four corner maps' bijectivity) or by restricting the datum to the explicitly typed Stage-3 output furnished under all hypotheses of lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum.
